title: Pages that move with your swipe
summary: The main screen now behaves like a page under your finger while the bottom tab slider keeps its direct movement.
changes: Drag the main Night, Changes or Breaks page left and the page itself moves left while the next tab enters from the right; drag right to return to the tab on the left.
The bottom tab bar keeps its existing direct behavior, so dragging its selector right still moves toward the tab on the right and dragging it left moves toward the tab on the left.
Short page drags settle back into place, vertical scrolling remains vertical, and forms, workflow controls, dialogs, Chat conversations and screen-edge gestures keep their existing interactions.
Roster calculations, Supabase data, authentication and the safe PWA update flow are unchanged.
